name: Kling AI CLI Skill
tagline: Use Kling's official CLI for image and video workflows in Cline
description: Official Kling AI CLI Skill for prompt planning, image and video workflows, reusable Elements, motion control, and task tracking. Pair it with the region-matching official CLI package and OAuth MCP connection: `@klingai/cli-global` for Global or `@klingai/cli-cn` for China. Generation consumes credits from the signed-in regional account.

install.notes: Install this skill with `cline skill install klingai-tech/skills` (the repo also documents `npx skills add klingai-tech/skills`). Install the matching npm CLI separately: `@klingai/cli-global` for Global or `@klingai/cli-cn` for China. Then complete OAuth with the same region's Kling account. Generation uses that account's credits.
